Video Merger

Join multiple video clips into one file, right in your browser. Clips play in order and are re-recorded into a single downloadable video.

Merges into WebM format — videos are re-encoded, so quality may change slightly. All processing happens on your device. The first clip sets the output size; other clips are letterboxed to fit.

📖 How to use

  1. Add two or more video files — they merge in the order shown.
  2. Reorder clips with the up/down arrows or remove ones you do not want.
  3. Click "Merge Videos" and wait while each clip is re-recorded in sequence.
  4. Download the single merged video file when it is ready.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the merging work?

Each clip is drawn onto a canvas frame-by-frame while its audio is routed through Web Audio, and one continuous MediaRecorder recording captures the whole sequence.

What resolution is the merged video?

Output size follows your first clip; other clips are letterboxed to fit. The output is WebM (MP4 on Safari) at a high bitrate.

Are my videos uploaded anywhere?

Yes — everything is processed locally on your device. No clip is ever uploaded.
